Name: Spooky gothic furniture
Author: Serpentwined
Description:
[b][b]Furniture[/b] Replacement Set[/b]
[i]New replacements for different furniture matching a spooky/goth theme. If you are using any other furniture replacements this will override them! This goes into the 'Tilesets' file' for Stardew Valley don't forget to make a backup copy of your original furniture.xnb![/i]

[b]Future plans:[/b]
[i]Going to work on patterns and textures on the couches, they seem to be pretyt lackluster compared to the rest, wanted to get this out though so keep checking for updates c:[/i]


[b]How to install:[/b]
[i]Download the file, unzip and place into the content folder for Stardew Valley. Should be located on in C:Program_Files/Steam/Steamapps/Common/Stardew_Valley/Tilesets[/i]

[i]Be sure to make a backup of your old files! The easiest way is to copy your 'Content' folder and rename is to something like 'Content Original' or 'Content Vanilla'. [/i]

[b]How to uninstall:[/b]
[i]If you have installed this mod manually and want to use the vanilla version again, replace these files from your original from the backup that you have made. Replace this file:[/i]

[i]furniture.xnb[/i]


[b] If you have forgotten to make a backup, NO WORRIES![/b][i] Simply delete the files listed and make a copy of your content folder (put on the desktop or somewhere outside of the stardew stream folder). Go to your library and right click Stardew Valley, select Programs and Local Files. Verify integrity of game cache and after this runs and completes you should have all the original vanilla files restored. Use the copied content folder without the mods that you no longer wanted to bring back the mods that you wish to keep. simply drag it back and everything should be good as new. [/i]
